summary: 8 repair targets are valid draft-question issues; all can be handled by small question-only rewrites in the downstream repair step.

items.title: 1. 推奨文が回答を含む
items.rationale: The review target is grounded in q1 and asks for removing an embedded recommendation/answer from the question text. This is a small directly supported draft-question rewrite.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[0].question begins with a recommendation and then asks whether to treat Issue #494 as a new refactor on current main.

items.title: 2. 推奨文が回答を含む
items.rationale: The review target is grounded in q2 and asks for converting a scope recommendation into a neutral question. This can be repaired without new user input.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[1].question presents the recommended target surface before asking whether to include additional command groups.

items.title: 3. 推奨文が指示を含む
items.rationale: The review target is grounded in q3 and identifies instruction-like wording inside the question. Removing the directive wording while preserving the compatibility question is a small draft change.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[2].question states a must-level restriction on use of the old branch before asking about exceptional compatibility behavior.

items.title: 4. 推奨文が受け入れ条件を含む
items.rationale: The review target is grounded in q4 and can be fixed by asking about acceptance-criteria scope without embedding the proposed acceptance criterion as the answer.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[3].question proposes dedicated authority classes and boundary rejection as acceptance criteria before asking whether helpers and fixtures are included.

items.title: 5. 推奨文が実装方針を含む
items.rationale: The review target is grounded in q5 and asks for removing an implementation/migration policy recommendation from the question text. The remaining compatibility-exception question is directly repairable.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[4].question recommends deleting legacy root inference fallback and using explicit boundary errors before asking about user-visible exceptions.

items.title: 6. 推奨文が実装方針を含む
items.rationale: The review target is grounded in q6 and can be fixed by making the fingerprint policy a neutral decision question rather than a recommended implementation direction.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[5].question recommends consolidating fingerprint capture and revalidation into a typed service before asking whether the policy is acceptable.

items.title: 7. 推奨文がscope制限を含む
items.rationale: The review target is grounded in q7 and asks for removing scope-limiting recommendation language. The target-identity scope question can be rewritten without inventing an answer.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[6].question states that the existing FlowTargetIdentityAuthority contract should be treated as authoritative before asking whether behavior changes are in scope.

items.title: 8. 推奨文が検証計画を含む
items.rationale: The review target is grounded in q8 and identifies a detailed proposed verification plan inside the question. It can be rewritten as a neutral question about required additional verification.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[7].question lists specific test files, focused tests, regression tests, and static audit work before asking whether more verification is required.
